name: MoYu Super AoLong AI 3x3 (Magnetic, MagLev, 20-Magnet Ball-Core, UV Coated) - Bluetooth Smart Cube
description: The MoYu Super AoLong AI 3x3 (Magnetic, MagLev, 20-Magnet Ball-Core, UV Coated) – Bluetooth Smart Cube is a flagship 3x3 speed cube that pairs elite hardware with full mobile-app connectivity. Piece magnets give precise layer “clicks,” MagLev removes spring friction for a faster feel, and a 20-magnet ball-core adds corner-to-core attraction for exceptional stability and alignment.
features: Learn and improve faster with real-time app guidance, races, and performance analytics.
Faster, more controllable turning from magnetic pieces, MagLev elasticity, and a 20-magnet ball-core.
Deep, repeatable tuning (512 combinations) to match your exact turning style.
UV-coated, high-grip finish at a compact 55.5 mm and ~75 g for confident, fatigue-free sessions.
Long battery life (up to 30 hours) and a charging case to keep you solving on the go.
Gyroscope magnetic core and AI sensing record motion data in real time; dynamic capture tracks cube state at any speed with 3D live sync in the app.
